name: D3DCompiler
notes: FXC (D3DCompile and D3DReflect) uses bin/10.0.22621.0/x64/d3dcompiler_47.dll (file version 10.0.22621.2428) of the pinned Windows SDK 10.0.22621.0. The d3dcompiler_47.dll in System32 differs per OS build and is not used (Docs/Design/ShaderSystem.ko.md section 8, item 2; UE also opens its bundled copy by full path).

The versioned bin/<sdk>/x64 copy is pinned instead of Redist/D3D/x64/d3dcompiler_47.dll because every later SDK overwrites the unversioned Redist path (measured 2026-11-21: after SDK 10.0.26100 it held 10.0.26100.9457 and bootstrap failed with a SHA mismatch). The versioned copy has the same file version and size as the 10.0.22621 Redist copy but a different SHA-256 (Redist copy measured in S10: af7b99be1b8770c0e4d18e43b04e81d11bdeb667fa6b07ade7a88f4c5676bf9a).

The Windows SDK is an installer and is not republished. bootstrap verifies the SHA-256 in the installed SDK and copies it to the user store (<file SHA-256>/d3dcompiler_47.dll) on the same machine; that is use of the installed SDK, not redistribution.

License: Windows SDK license terms, Distributable Code. The REDIST.TXT list (learn.microsoft.com/legal/windows-sdk/redist, updated 2024-10-21) names Redist\D3D\x64\d3dcompiler_47.dll by path; the versioned bin copy pinned here is not on the list. A developer tool package that gives FXC to other people must carry the Redist\D3D\x64 copy, pinned separately when that package is made, unmodified and only with Classic Windows (desktop) applications (measurement S10, Docs/Design/ShaderSystem.ko.md section 8, item 2). No files are committed to the repository, so there is no licenses entry. Runtime executables do not ship it (Release exclusion, section 9).
